responsibility: Documents the purpose and programming model of the vendored datafrog crate that underlies Polonius evaluation in gccrs borrow checking. It describes datafrog as an embeddable lightweight Datalog engine, explains its iteration/variable/update-rule API with join-based examples, and serves as dependency reference material for the fixed-point relation engine rather than implementing GCC-side borrow-check logic itself.
same_name_distinction: Among the vendored README.md files, this one documents datafrog specifically: the embedded Datalog/fixed-point engine API and rule iteration model used beneath Polonius, unlike the sibling READMEs for the logging facade, the Polonius analysis engine, or the rustc-hash crate.
